# Skills

Project-only skills, loaded natively by Claude Code and Codex.

## Folders

- [add-agent-tool/](add-agent-tool/INDEX.md) — **add-agent-tool**: Add or change a tool the ReAct agent can call (schema, code, observation, tests, tracing, eval). Use whenever agent/tools.py or prompts/tools.json changes.
- [codex-review/](codex-review/INDEX.md) — **codex-review**: Get an independent Codex review of a plan or a diff, then log each finding as fixed or rejected. Use before merging a big change (new module, agent loop, ingest) or when the user asks for a review.
- [debug-trace/](debug-trace/INDEX.md) — **debug-trace**: Find why one answer was wrong, starting from its failure label and trace, and choose what to fix. Use when an eval question fails or an /ask answer looks wrong.
- [prompt-change/](prompt-change/INDEX.md) — **prompt-change**: Change a prompt or a tool description safely. Use for any edit under src/corpusqa/prompts/.
- [run-eval/](run-eval/INDEX.md) — **run-eval**: Run the eval (retrieval, smoke, tune, held-out or the whole golden set) against a running server and read the report. Use after any change to prompts, tools, retrieval, chunking or caps, and before calling such a change done.
